title: Mule - an interactive interface to asset generation based on 3D sketching
author: corysama
selftext:
In this video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=68kzhZHkPf0 the artist Felix Barthe explains his frustration with existing interfaces for 3D asset generation and how he vibed up a better interface for himself.

I am not Felix. I post this mainly because I appreciate his discussion on how to improve the experience of using generative tools from the POV of a professional artist rather than the usual POV of a coder just trying to make anything work at all :P

At the end of the vid he says he wants to open-source it eventually. But, it's still in an experimental phase.
